title.en: The corpus's conditional laws in the grammar, each with a net where its condition fails
title.zh: 语料之有条件之律写入文法，各有其条件不成立之网

statement.en: Of the corpus's 219 conditional units, 128 fall into 22 families of laws, each written as Y iff Z or Z then Y with a net where Z fails and Y with it: 103 state laws that hold, 6 laws false as read, 19 premises. Of the rest, 33 turn on a valuation, 53 are not expressible, 5 are definitions.
statement.zh: 语料归为丙一之 219 条中，128 条入 22 族，每律写成“Y 当且仅当 Z”或“Z 则 Y”，各有 Z 不成立而 Y 亦不成立之网：103 条之律成立，6 条依读法不成立，19 条是前提；其余 33 条转于评价，53 条表达不了，5 条是定义。

laws.en: Where everything goes on under a coarse class and every step of 缘 is parted by a fine class, every occurrence is generating (全生成): the coarse line never ends and a carrying renewal lies ahead of every point it reaches; day and night are an instance. Sufficient, the converse not claimed: a line that ends, and a step that keeps the class, do not generate.
laws.zh: 凡事于粗类皆有后，且缘之每步皆为细类所分，则每事全生成：粗线不穷，其所及之每处之后皆有传；昼夜为其例。充分，其逆不论：有终之线与不分之步皆不全生成。
declarations: Becoming.«皆有后而步皆分则全生成»
Becoming.«步不分而不全生成之例»

laws.en: Bounded room on the line itself: a line none of whose places comes back to itself is shorter than any list holding its places, so where a list holds the line from an occurrence, that line is not endless, though no end is exhibited. A line that comes back, or one no list holds, may never end; a merge, or no bound, keeps a line from coming back to its start.
laws.zh: 线上有界之室：线上之处皆不返于自身者，短于任一列其处之表；故有一表列自某事之线时，此线非不穷，然不示一终。返者或无表者可不穷；有并或无界，则线不返其始。

laws.en: 前際 and 後際 mirror each other under the converse. What a class's core puts with an occurrence whose line never ends has a line that never ends, so an endless line and one that ends lie apart under the core, as ending is kept along the core and beginning along the core of the converse net. The forward core does not keep a beginning, the converse core relates pairs the core does not, and a line without beginning can end.
laws.zh: 前际与后际于逆下相映：类之核所合于线不穷之事者，其线亦不穷，故不穷之线与有终之线于核下相分；如亡沿核不变，生沿逆缘之核不变。前向之核不保生，逆缘之核合核所不合者，无始之线可有终。

laws.en: Dependence along 缘 (依: every occurrence with Q has a condition with P) is one-way. Where nothing is P, nothing is Q, and dependences compose along «而», so a chain of them is one law. Where Q has no P-condition, Q stands though nothing is P.
laws.zh: 沿缘之依（每一有 Q 之事皆有一有 P 之缘）单向。无 P 则无 Q；依沿「而」相传，故一串依是一律。Q 无 P 之缘时，无 P 而 Q 仍立。

laws.en: Passing through: where a class is constant under 缘 and its converse, whatever has a predecessor passes through, altered or not, as the grammar's reading of 通 has it. The condition is sufficient, not necessary: under a class that is not constant an occurrence can end, alter and pass through. With no predecessor it does not pass through, though the class be constant both ways.
laws.zh: 通：类于缘与其逆两向有常时，有前者通，不论异否，如文法对通之读。此条件充分而非必要：不有常之类下，一事可亡、异而通。无前则不通，虽类两向有常。
declarations: Becoming.«两向有常而无前不通之例»

laws.en: What has ended under one class passes through under another only by altering; where that other is constant both ways, it alters exactly where it passes through, and exactly where it has a successor there. The constancy is sufficient, not necessary; without it what alters can fail to pass through. What has not ended under the parting class can pass through unaltered, and can alter; where every step is parted, everything has ended.
laws.zh: 亡于一类者，于他类通必经异；他类两向有常时，恰于异处通，亦恰于有后处异。有常足之而非必要，不有常则异可不通。未亡于所分之类者可不异而通，亦可异；步皆分则皆亡。
declarations: Becoming.«亡而两向有常则异当且仅当通»

laws.en: Three definitional laws state families exactly: what ends under a class alters, continued under another, exactly where it has a successor there, and with none ceases without altering; nothing alters under E and F (continued under E, told apart by F) exactly where F holds of the ends of every continuation under E; nothing begins under the one exactly where nothing lacks a condition, both up to double negation.
laws.zh: 三条定义之律确切陈述其族：亡于一类者，恰于他类有后处异（他类续之），无后则息而不异；无 E 下之续其两端为 F 所分者（无异），恰当 F 于 E 下每一续之两端成立；无事无缘，恰在“一”之下无事生；后二者皆在双重否定之下。
declarations: Becoming.«皆不生当且仅当皆非无缘»

laws.en: Each family whose law the grammar's modules already state has a net where Z fails and Y fails with it: a lone occurrence, with no condition and no result, begins and ends under the one; counting at one ends under identity and abides under the one; a net without cycles has nothing co-present; the empty net has nothing conditioning. A joint class on three bits joining two distinct points witnesses 相须.
laws.zh: 文法诸模块已陈其律之族，各有 Z 不成立而 Y 亦不成立之网：孤事无缘无果，在“一”之下生且亡；计数于一，在同一之类下亡而在“一”之下住；无环之网无俱有；空网无能。三位之合类合二异点，为相须之见证。
declarations: Becoming.«非有常之类不含于核之例»

hypotheses.en: Each reading of a unit as a law is an AI reconstruction, and each count counts readings: groups.tsv keeps every unit's family, disposition, labelled reading and the classifier's confidence. The classical text decides nothing; Lean checks only the derivation.
hypotheses.zh: 每条读作一律，是 AI 之重构，计数是读法之计数：groups.tsv 存每条之族、处置、带标之读法与归类者之信度。古文不判，Lean 只检推导。

hypotheses.en: The grammar's modelling choices: one carrier for every kind (perceivers and percepts fall under one class); 缘 a necessary relation between places of the net, with no predicate of presence; classes as relations; discrete steps.
hypotheses.zh: 文法之模型选择：诸种共一载体（知者与所知落于一类）；缘为网中处所间之必要关系，无“在”之谓词；类为关系；离散之步。

hypotheses.en: G01's reading takes two classes, the one ended under and the one continued under, and G01 and G06 take a class constant under 缘 and its converse: premises the texts do not state.
hypotheses.zh: G01 之读取二类，所亡之类与所续之类；G01 与 G06 取于缘与其逆两向有常之类：皆文本未陈之前提。

hypotheses.en: G03 and G04 add a bound the texts do not state: a list holding the line's places, bounded room.
hypotheses.zh: G03 与 G04 另设文本未陈之界：一表列线之处，即有界之室。

hypotheses.en: G08 (what occurs has conditions) and G20 (同類同情 as constancy) are premises of the model, not theorems. G13 assumes the occurrence is not its own condition; G21's converse assumes that being told apart at no stage is constant and the class symmetric.
hypotheses.zh: G08（凡事有缘）与 G20（同類同情为有常）是模型之前提，不是定理。G13 设此事不自缘；G21 之逆设“无一层能分”有常且类对称。

hypotheses.en: Each net where Z fails is one constructed model on a small carrier (Unit, Bool, Option, Nat), or a model the package already has.
hypotheses.zh: 每张 Z 不成立之网，是小载体（Unit、Bool、Option、Nat）上之一构造模型，或包中已有之模型。

does_not_show.en: That the texts state these laws or their authors meant them: a reading stands or is revised by its place in one account, and no person's review of these readings is recorded.
does_not_show.zh: 文本陈述此诸律，或其作者意谓之：读法以其在一说明中之位而立或改，且尚无人审此诸读法之记录。

does_not_show.en: That ending gives altering, or altering passing through, with no premise, or any order in time: what ends can cease, what alters can fail to pass through; alone a step need not reverse, and for what has ended, premises joined, all are one.
does_not_show.zh: 亡给异、异给通而无前提，或其步有时序：亡者可息，异者可不通；各步只带其前提时其逆不必成；于亡者，他类两向有常时，有后、异、通、往不穷相当；二类及其有常，文本不言。

does_not_show.en: Which 變 the text means, which it does not say: the 疏 and the commentators who borrow it are near change at the limit; 上十二 has words near alternation, its example from 亢 to 通; as alternation at every step (上十一), 窮 selects no place.
does_not_show.zh: 文本言何變，文本未明言：此句本处与上文之疏、借此句之注近窮而后变；上十二有近于交替之语，其例自亢至通；读作每步交替（上十一），窮无处不在，不拣选何处。

does_not_show.en: That the order is every recension's: the 音義 at the sentence's own place records one without 變則通.
does_not_show.zh: 此序是各本之序：此句本处音義记一本无「變則通」。

does_not_show.en: Production or sufficiency: 生 as producing an occurrence not yet there is not expressible, since 缘 is a necessary relation between places of the net.
does_not_show.zh: 生产与充足：以生为产出尚未在之事，不可表达，因缘是网中处所间之必要关系。

does_not_show.en: That constancy is necessary for never ending or for passing through: both laws give sufficient conditions, with nets where the condition fails and the conclusion holds.
does_not_show.zh: 有常为不穷或通之必要：二律皆给充分条件，有其条件不成立而结论成立之网。

does_not_show.en: That what depends on the beginningless is beginningless (JS-324 read through 故): what depends on a line without beginning can begin.
does_not_show.zh: 依于无始者亦无始（JS-324 读故为依）：依于无始之线者可以有始。

does_not_show.en: The 91 units outside the families: the 33 that turn on a valuation and the 53 not expressible are kept with their reasons in groups.tsv, not forced in.
does_not_show.zh: 族外之 91 条：转于评价者 33 条、表达不了者 53 条，皆以其由存于 groups.tsv，不强入。

detail.en: CWS-P6+P7+P8-020, G11, read as the converse of 相须: a class that is not constant, under which a line never ends. («不有常而不穷之例»)
detail.zh: CWS-P6+P7+P8-020（G11）读作相须之逆：类不有常，其下之线不穷。（«不有常而不穷之例»）

detail.en: ZL-21-113, G13: counting at one ends under identity and abides under the one, so not abiding under identity is not 斷. («亡于静而住于一之例»)
detail.zh: ZL-21-113（G13）：计数于一，在同一之类下亡而在“一”之下住，故不住于同一之类非断。（«亡于静而住于一之例»）

detail.en: ZL-17-051, G13: on the witness a result with no condition at all, not only no deed, abides under no class, so not 常, while another occurrence, the deed, has a successor, so not 斷. («无缘不住而他有后之例»)
detail.zh: ZL-17-051（G13）：见证中果全无缘（不只无业），于任何类下不住，非常；另一事（业）有后，非断。（«无缘不住而他有后之例»）

detail.en: ZL-01-099, G16: what has no condition can end, and it abides under no class, so it is not 常. («生亡并之例»)
detail.zh: ZL-01-099（G16）：无缘者可亡，且于任何类下不住，非常。（«生亡并之例»）

detail.en: ZL-02-070, G16: own position read as own condition gives no beginning under any class; the unit is the premise of a reductio. («自缘而不生之例»)
detail.zh: ZL-02-070（G16）：读定性为自缘，则于任何类下不生；此条是归谬之前提。（«自缘而不生之例»）

detail.en: QXL-JS-324, G15, read through dependence: what depends on a line without beginning can begin, given a class that tells the two kinds apart. («依于无始而有始之例»)
detail.zh: QXL-JS-324（G15）读故为依：依于无始之线者可以有始，须一类分开二种。（«依于无始而有始之例»）

validation_scope.en: Pure core, every axiom report empty: GrammarConditionals imports GrammarCandidates and GrammarLaws, a leaf nothing imports. The two general laws two families rest on are stated in the records of the laws they generalize, continuation relative to a class and the classical definitions. Written by an AI from the corpus's classification; one independent AI review, every finding taken; no person's audit of the readings recorded. The leaf, 48 theorems in 49 declarations, compiles with the whole package in the core run whose receipt the record binds.
validation_scope.zh: 纯核，公理报告皆空：GrammarConditionals 引 GrammarCandidates 与 GrammarLaws，无模块引之。二族所依之两条一般之律，陈于其所推广之律之记录：相对于类的续与古文之定义。由 AI 据语料之归类写成；经一次独立之 AI 审查，所见皆取；读法无人工审核。此叶 49 声明中定理 48，与全包同编译于记录所系收据之核心运行。

next_delta.en: Review of the readings by a person (classicists, Buddhist scholars, logicians); whether the 起信论 counts 無明 among its 煩惱染法 (JS-318), which its text does not settle and no reading needs; whether G01's 變 is change at the limit or alternation at every step, which the text does not say (the glosses on it or using it are near the former); the 181 candidates of the three added texts.
next_delta.zh: 人审读法（古文、佛学、逻辑学者）；《起信论》是否以無明为其煩惱染法（JS-318；文本不能定，亦无读须之）；G01 之變是窮極之变还是每步交替（文本未明言；及此句之注近前者）；后加三部文本之 181 条候选。

correspondence.en: Units, families, dispositions and labelled readings in _process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/development/ou7-conditional-laws/data/groups.tsv: law 103, false as read 6, premise 19, 丁 33, not expressible 53, 甲 5. Each family's Z, Y, laws, net where Z fails and standing are tabled in 06 §四, and argued in the study's DESIGN.md.
correspondence.zh: 逐条之族、处置与带标之读法见 groups.tsv：律 103，依读法不成立 6，前提 19，丁 33，表达不了 53，甲 5。每族之 Z、Y、律、Z 不成立之网与地位，列于第六章 §四，论于其研究之 DESIGN.md。

aliases: conditional laws of the corpus, family by family
Becoming.«皆有后而步皆分则全生成»

detail.en: Twelve families' laws come from GrammarCandidates («相由则俱有», «四相俱时», «自缘则常», «定性之判», «有相则非亦有相», «能所相待», «不可致诘而有常则混而为一», «尺与端或尽或不尽» and others); its «从缘生非文法之律», «致诘不尽», «有生不必有亡» and «尺与尺可相尽» are nets where Z fails.
detail.zh: 十二族之律出于 GrammarCandidates（«相由则俱有»、«四相俱时»、«自缘则常»、«定性之判»、«有相则非亦有相»、«能所相待»、«不可致诘而有常则混而为一»、«尺与端或尽或不尽» 等）；其 «从缘生非文法之律»、«致诘不尽»、«有生不必有亡»、«尺与尺可相尽» 是 Z 不成立之网。

detail.en: «通», «有常则往不穷», «非一非异», «有常而不通» and «昼夜往来不穷»; its law 4, generalized at this landing: under a class constant both ways what has a predecessor passes through («两向有常有前则通»), what abides being its case («两向有常则通»). The family of 通 rests on it.
detail.zh: «通»、«有常则往不穷»、«非一非异»、«有常而不通»、«昼夜往来不穷»；其律 4 于此次落地推广：类两向有常时，有前者通（«两向有常有前则通»），住者为其一例（«两向有常则通»）。通之族依之。

detail.en: The four marks, constancy, the core and the two-way core, «息» and «无环»; its law 5, generalized at this landing: beginning is kept along the core of the converse net («生于逆核下不变»), which holds the two-way core («位核含于逆核»), «生于位核下不变» its case. The family of 前際 and 後際 rests on it.
detail.zh: 四相、有常、核与双向之核、«息»、«无环»；其律 5 于此次落地推广：生沿逆缘之核不变（«生于逆核下不变»），此核含双向之核（«位核含于逆核»），«生于位核下不变» 为其一例。前际后际之族依之。

detail.en: GrammarLaws' pigeonhole and finite-line laws («线有限不并则返», «有限遍后定前则皆返», «定前») and the image of a relation («像», «保之像»).
detail.zh: GrammarLaws 之鸽笼与有限之线之律（«线有限不并则返»、«有限遍后定前则皆返»、«定前»）与关系之像（«像»、«保之像»）。

detail.en: «全生成», «传» and «所及», the short line and the still occurrence (Map.short, Map.still), and «全生成全守不并».
detail.zh: «全生成»、«传» 与 «所及»，短线与静事（Map.short、Map.still），及 «全生成全守不并»。

detail.en: G21's «可分则不在核», with GrammarTesting's stages; the home section states the stagings of inquiry and of testing as one relation.
detail.zh: G21 之 «可分则不在核» 与 GrammarTesting 之层；家节陈诘之层与验之层为一关系。

history.en: 1 November 2026, board item OU7 (study section 492): added. The 219 units classed 丙一 read as laws of every carrier, relation and class, 128 of them in 22 families, each law with a net where its condition fails; the new laws and the witnesses in one core leaf, Becoming.GrammarConditionals; the two general laws two families rest on, in Grammar and GrammarReadings, stated in the records of the laws they generalize (continuation-relative-to-a-class, law 5; classical-definitions-in-the-grammar, law 4); one independent AI review of the design, every finding taken.
history.zh: 2026年11月1日，工作板条目 OU7（研究第 492 节）：增。归为丙一之 219 条读作对一切载体、关系与类之律，其中 128 条入 22 族，每律有其条件不成立之网；新律与见证在一核心之叶 Becoming.GrammarConditionals；二族所依之两条一般之律在 Grammar 与 GrammarReadings，陈于其所推广之律之记录（continuation-relative-to-a-class 律 5；classical-definitions-in-the-grammar 律 4）；设计经一次独立之 AI 审查，所见皆取。

history.en: 3 November 2026, the dossiers' re-sync: a correction. The first of the false-as-read witnesses for ZL-17-051 said more than the Lean states: its result has no condition at all, and a result with another condition can abide. The chapter's sentence and groups.tsv's row with it; the chapter's opening and home section now say, as this statement does, that 128 of the 219 are written as laws; its open list says what JS-318 denies, which is not JS-326's own premise. The statement and every count stand.
history.zh: 2026年11月3日，诸材料之再核：更正。ZL-17-051 之见证原说得比 Lean 所陈为多：其果全无缘，有他缘之果可住。章中之句与 groups.tsv 之行随之改；章之开头与本节今如本记录所陈，说 219 条中 128 条写成律；其未决之条说 JS-318 所否者，不是 JS-326 自己之前提。所陈与诸计数不变。

history.en: 5 November 2026, board item RAE3 (AA Phase 0's E26): the open readings read in the corpus. G22: 「衡不正」 is, by Xunzi's own sentence (杨倞's gloss, outside the corpus, reads it otherwise), a reversal of the pair weighed, so 「重縣於仰」 is the text's stated consequence, not derived from non-preservation; whether every pair reverses the text does not say. G15: the 起信论's accord sense of 相應 (contrary, in the 勝鬘, 離, 脫, 異) is read as one class of the forward core, by fit, the text not choosing between the core and sameness of substance; whether 無明 is among its 煩惱染法 the text does not settle, and the carry-over to JS-324 fails either way. G01: the 繫辭 defines 變 twice with 謂之 and states the order with 則; whether its 變 is one alteration or an alternation the text does not settle: the commentators who borrow it to gloss other lines (韩注 and 孔疏 at 上五, 朱熹 on 困上六; 程颐 on 既济 near them) read one change at the extreme, while where 韩注 quotes it outright (上十二) 孔疏 glosses 變 as 化裁, near alternation, as 程颐 on 否 is. Each [AI reading, new] in 06; no law, standing or count changed.
history.zh: 2026年11月5日，看板项 RAE3（AA 第零阶段之 E26）：未决之读依语料而读。G22：依荀子本句（杨倞注在语料之外，读之不同），「衡不正」是所衡之对反转，故「重縣於仰」是文本所陈之所致，非由“不保”推出；是否每对皆反，文本不言。G15：《起信论》相合义之相應（其反在《勝鬘》为離、脫、異）依合读作同在前向之核之一类，文不分核与同体；無明是否在其煩惱染法中，文本不能定，移用于 JS-324 皆不成。G01：系辞以「謂之」界说變者二，以「則」陈序；其變是一次之异还是往来交替，文本不能定：注家借此句释他文者（韩注、孔疏于上五，朱熹于困上六；程颐既济注近之）读作窮極之一变；韩注于上十二直引此句，孔疏彼处以化裁释變，与程颐否注同近于交替。06 中各标 [AI reading, new]；律、地位与计数均未改。

history.en: 6 November 2026, board item RAE5 (ED4's classical reader's E4C-01, E4C-02, E4C-20 to E4C-55): a correction. OU7 and RAE3 said that in the grammar the three of 穷 → 变 → 通 are only a conjunction with no order to find, and that 變 does nothing for 通. That was not so: what has ended under one class passes through under another only by altering; altering gives passing through where that class is constant both ways, a sufficient premise; and for what has ended, under it, having a successor, altering, passing through and never ending going are one. The grammar gives the steps as implications, with no order in time; each step with only its own premise need not reverse. What survives of the earlier claim is that what has not ended under the parting class can pass through unaltered, that the parting does no work in the step to 通, and, for what has ended with the premises joined, that the four have no direction among them. Eight short theorems say so in GrammarConditionals, three of them witnesses, and the record's laws, premises and non-implications follow; the premises are the reading's, the text not stating them, and the proofs are short derivations, not new mathematics. G01 is also read at the sentence's own place, 系辞下, whose 注 and 疏 lie outside the corpus; the passage is kept in the review packet's editions folder from an electronic copy of 《周易注疏》 (四库全书本, Wikisource revision 9685969), not collated with a print. 孔疏 there states the order with a reason and reads change at the limit, as its gloss on 通其變 above it does and as the commentators who borrow the sentence do; 孔疏's example at 上十二 runs from 亢 to 通. Under alternation at every step every place has ended under the parting class, so 窮 holds everywhere and selects no place. So RAE3's balance, that the text does not settle, became that the text does not say whether 窮 lies at the limit or at every step and the glosses lean; the text's 變 is written change at the limit, not one alteration, the 疏 having 隨時 and 日新. The 音義 there records a recension without 變則通, so the step from 變 to 通 is the received text's. groups.tsv's rows for XCX-02-008, QXL-JS-326, XZ-ZM-164 and XZ-ZM-165 now give §四's readings. Each [AI reading, new] in 06; no count of the corpus or standing changed.
history.zh: 2026年11月6日，看板项 RAE5（ED4 古典读者之 E4C-01、E4C-02、E4C-20 至 E4C-55）：更正。OU7 与 RAE3 言文法中穷 → 变 → 通三者只是合取、无序可求，变于通无所为；不实：亡于一类者于他类通必经异；他类两向有常足以使异者通；于亡者，其下有后、异、通、往不穷四者相当。文法给其步以蕴含，不给时序；各步只带其前提时其逆不必成。前言所余者：未亡于所分之类者可不异而通，一类之分于至通之一步不出力，而于亡者、他类两向有常时，四者之间无方向。GrammarConditionals 增八条短定理言之，其三为见证，记录之律、前提与不示随之；前提是此读之前提，文本不言；证皆定义之短推导，不是新数学。G01 亦依此句本处（系辞下）而读，其注疏在语料之外；其段存于审查包之 editions，录自《周易注疏》（四库全书本）之电子本（维基文库修订版 9685969），未与刻本对校。孔疏彼处陈其序与其由，读作窮極之变，其释上文「通其變」与注家借此句者亦然；孔疏于上十二之例自亢至通。每步交替之读下每处皆亡于所分之类，窮无处不在，不拣选何处。故 RAE3 之两可，今为文本未明言窮在极处还是每步而注疏有所近；文本之變写作窮極之变，不写一次之异，疏有「隨時」「日新」。彼处音義记一本无「變則通」，故自變至通之一步只就通行本而言。groups.tsv 中 XCX-02-008、QXL-JS-326、XZ-ZM-164、XZ-ZM-165 之行今依 §四。皆 06 中之 [AI reading, new]；语料之计数与地位不变。

history.en: 6 November 2026, board item LM: the witness that what alters need not have ended (`«异而未亡之例»`) joins law 6; `«亡而两向有常则异当且仅当通»`'s docstring says its scope; `«缕之无定性»` is `«四相俱时»` in groups.tsv, three of its four positions.
history.zh: 2026年11月6日，工作板条目 LM：异者未必亡之见证（`«异而未亡之例»`）入律 6；`«亡而两向有常则异当且仅当通»` 之说明言其范围；groups.tsv 中 `«缕之无定性»` 作 `«四相俱时»`，其四相之三。
